# Definition
A ***upper triangular matrix*** is an $m \times n$ matrix such that $A_{ij} = 0$ whenever $i > j$, and a ***lower triangular matrix*** is an $m \times n$ matrix such that $A_{ij} = 0$ whenver $i < j$. 

# Theorem
Let $A$ be an $n \times n$ triangular matrix. Then $\det(A)$ equals the product of the diagonal entries of $A$.

# Reference
- S. H. Friedberg, A. J. Insel, and L. E. Spence, Linear Algebra, 4th ed. (Pearson New International Edition), Pearson, 2013.
